## Progress

- Merged [PR #39](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/39): BFF sign-in in Host.Api — OIDC code + PKCE, tokens never stored, `__Host-medvya` HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookie, MFA required (`amr`), Medvya accounts only (`identity.Users`), CSRF header on state-changing calls, same-site return URLs, rate-limited login; `/bff/login`, `/bff/logout`, `/v1/me/context`; clinic app Sign in / Sign out
- Development-only OIDC provider lists the seeded synthetic users; 8 integration tests on SQL Server, mutation-checked (MFA, account, return URL, CSRF, HttpOnly); verified in the browser (English, Arabic RTL, axe clean; no token in JS-readable cookies or storage)
- Left (needs Entra External ID, MDV-P0-003/006): real provider config, passkeys, F-03 custom UI, lockout copy, recovery, SSO-enforced tenants; sign-in events are now audited on facility choice (PR #65)

## Description

Implement OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE against Microsoft Entra External ID inside Host.Api (BFF). Tokens stay server-side; the browser gets an HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Strict session cookie and an antiforgery token. MFA is mandatory for all staff (TOTP authenticator; passkeys preferred; SMS OTP only as fallback where allowed). Account recovery flow. Screen F-03: email or mobile → "Continue with passkey" / "Use a one-time code instead" → 6-digit code → facility picker.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A staff user cannot reach any authenticated page or API without completing MFA.
- [ ] **AC2.** After sign-in no access or refresh token is readable from JavaScript (document.cookie and storage contain none).
- [ ] **AC3.** Wrong codes are counted and the account is locked by the identity provider (Entra smart lockout: threshold and 15-minute duration set and recorded in the runbook), because codes are typed on the provider's pages and Medvya never sees them; Medvya rate-limits starting sign-in. The "2 attempts left" copy is the provider's, not ours.
- [ ] **AC4.** Passkey-unsupported browsers fall back to the one-time code path with a clear message.
- [ ] **AC5.** An SSO-enforced tenant (placeholder flag for P7) hides password/OTP options and shows "Hospital staff? Sign in with SSO".
- [ ] **AC6.** Recovery ("Can't sign in?") leads to the provider's self-service recovery, which re-verifies identity and re-enrols MFA; Medvya's own pages never reveal whether an account exists (sign-in start takes no email).
- [ ] **AC7.** Sign-in, refusals and sign-outs that Medvya sees are written to the audit log (MDV-P0-017); provider-side failures, lockouts and recovery are in the Entra sign-in log, and the runbook says how to read it.
